bridge-type.label: Tractive Account
bridge-type.description: Connects to the Tractive cloud using your account credentials. All tracker things require this bridge.

thing-type.label: Tractive Dog 6
thing-type.description: A Tractive Dog 6 GPS pet tracker. Provides real-time location, battery, health data, and commands.

parameter.name: trackedPetId
parameter.label: Pet ID
parameter.description: Tractive pet (trackable object) ID linked to this tracker

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often to re-poll position, hardware battery level, and health/dog data as a backstop alongside the real-time channel (seconds). Defaults to 180; set to 0 to rely on the real-time channel alone, which means some Channels never get updated. Tracker Status, Device Info, and Profile are never on this interval.

channel-type.label: Last Position Time
channel-type.description: Time of the most recent position report

channel-type.label: Speed
channel-type.description: Current movement speed (null when stationary)

channel-type.label: Sensor Used
channel-type.description: Positioning sensor used for the last fix (GPS, KNOWN_WIFI, PHONE)

channel-type.label: Position Accuracy
channel-type.description: Estimated position uncertainty in metres (always 30 for KNOWN_WIFI)

channel-type.label: Nearby User ID
Temperature State
channel-type.description: A hardware temperature-related state; always null in every capture taken so far, meaning unresolved

channel-type.label: Charging State
channel-type.description: Current charging state (e.g. CHARGING, NOT_CHARGING)

channel-type.label: Battery State
channel-type.description: Battery health state (e.g. FULL, REGULAR, LOW)

channel-type.label: Tracker State
channel-type.description: Operational state of the tracker (e.g. OPERATIONAL)

channel-type.label: Zone Type
channel-type.description: Kind of the currently most relevant geofence zone (POWER_SAVING, SAFE, DANGER)

channel-type.label: Last Contact
channel-type.description: Time of the most recent successful contact with this tracker, via REST poll or real-time channel event

channel-type.label: Buzzer
channel-type.description: Activates or deactivates the tracker buzzer

channel-type.label: LED
channel-type.description: Activates or deactivates the tracker LED

channel-type.label: Live Tracking
channel-type.description: Enables or disables live tracking mode (higher GPS update rate)

channel-type.label: Active Time
channel-type.description: Total time of activity recorded today

channel-type.label: Activity Goal
channel-type.description: Daily activity time goal

channel-type.label: Daytime Sleep
channel-type.description: Total time of daytime sleep today

channel-type.label: Night Sleep
channel-type.description: Total time of night-time sleep today

channel-type.label: Calm Time
channel-type.description: Total time of calm (resting but not sleep) today

channel-type.label: Heart Rate Status
channel-type.description: Heart rate status from health overview (e.g. NORMAL)

channel-type.label: Respiratory Rate Status
channel-type.description: Respiratory rate status from health overview (e.g. NORMAL)

channel-type.label: Unseen Health Alerts
channel-type.description: Number of unseen health alerts

channel-type.label: Activity Synced At
channel-type.description: Time when the activity data was last synced from the tracker

channel-type.label: Bark Status
channel-type.description: Bark detection status from health overview (e.g. NORMAL, ELEVATED)

channel-type.label: Scratch Status
channel-type.description: Scratch detection status from health overview (e.g. INFREQUENT)

channel-type.label: Activity Hourly Distribution
channel-type.description: Tractive's 24-element per-hour activity breakdown of the current day: a comma-separated list of 24 integers

channel-type.label: Day Offset
channel-type.description: Which day the sibling status channel's value covers: 0 = today, -1 = yesterday. Reads -1 while today's value is not yet available (typically during the pet's active daytime hours, before it has had a fresh resting period), then flips to 0.

channel-type.label: Associated Report Types
channel-type.description: Comma-separated types of the reports bundled with the health overview (e.g. HEALTH_WEEKLY_REPORT)

channel-type.label: Separation Phase Ongoing
channel-type.description: Whether a separation-anxiety monitoring phase is currently ongoing for this pet. Send ON to start a phase, OFF to stop the current one. The confirmed state arrives via the health overview a few seconds later; until then the channel shows openHAB's optimistic echo.

channel-type.label: Separation Phase Started At
channel-type.description: When the current separation-anxiety monitoring phase started; undefined while none is ongoing

channel-type.label: Tracker State Reason
channel-type.description: Why the tracker's operational state is what it is (e.g. POWER_SAVING, STALE_POSITION)

channel-type.label: Zone ID
channel-type.description: Internal ID of the geofence zone currently most relevant to the tracker's position

channel-type.label: Zone Entered At
channel-type.description: Time the tracker entered its currently most relevant geofence zone

channel-type.label: Zone Last Seen At
channel-type.description: Time the tracker was last confirmed still inside its currently most relevant geofence zone

channel-type.label: Power Saving Zone ID
channel-type.description: Internal ID of the tracker's configured Power Saving Zone

channel-type.label: Battery Save Mode
channel-type.description: Whether the tracker's aggressive battery-save mode is enabled. This is a cloud-side account setting (not a device command); it takes effect within about 30 seconds regardless of whether the tracker is currently dormant. A change made in the Tractive app is only reflected here after the next "Refresh hardware" action, REFRESH command, or Thing restart.

channel-type.label: Subscription Status
channel-type.description: Status of the Tractive subscription covering this tracker (e.g. ACTIVE). A non-active subscription disables commands, live tracking, and real-time updates. Fetched at Thing setup or via the "Refresh hardware" action, never on the regular polling schedule.

channel-type.label: Subscription Valid To
channel-type.description: Date the Tractive subscription covering this tracker is paid through

channel-type.label: Command Timeout
channel-type.description: Configured maximum duration this activation is allowed to run before auto-stopping

channel-type.label: Command Remaining
channel-type.description: Seconds left before this activation auto-stops

channel-type.label: Command Pending
channel-type.description: Whether the cloud has accepted this command but the tracker has not yet executed it

channel-type.label: Command Reconnecting
channel-type.description: Whether the tracker was mid-reconnect while this command was outstanding; has been OFF in every real capture taken so far

channel-type.label: Command Started At
channel-type.description: When this activation started; undefined while inactive

channel-type.label: Height
channel-type.description: The pet's height, as entered in the Tractive app. Only refreshed at Thing setup or via the "Refresh profile" action. Writable for the pet's owner account; a shared/read-only account's command is rejected (logged, not sent) -- see the Note below.

channel-type.label: Weight
channel-type.description: The pet's weight, as entered in the Tractive app. Only refreshed at Thing setup or via the "Refresh profile" action. Writable for the pet's owner account; a shared/read-only account's command is rejected (logged, not sent) -- see the Note below.

channel-type.label: Home Location
channel-type.description: The pet's configured home location, as entered in the Tractive app. Only refreshed at Thing setup or via the "Refresh profile" action.

channel-type.label: Profile Last Updated
channel-type.description: Time the Profile channel group was last fetched — at Thing setup or via the "Refresh profile" action, never on the regular polling schedule
